01 CREATIVE MIND
A little piece of my world

Hi, I’m Habiba.I create with feeling.

I’m a Creative Designer, AI Content Creator & Video Editor who loves turning simple ideas into visuals that feel alive.

I believe good design is more than something beautiful to look at. It should have a mood, tell a story, and leave a little feeling behind. From graphic design and social media visuals to AI-powered content and video, I’m always looking for a more creative way to bring an idea to life.
